author: Ahmetselim
quote: The game no longer feels like a GTA title; the steps taken to make it more realistic don’t actually make it any more fun or engaging. In my opinion, a game is a form of entertainment, not a real-life simulator—striving for realism doesn’t always result in a better game. I found parts like the house-tidying sequence at the beginning—and various other tedious missions—incredibly boring precisely because they were so hyper-realistic.
